## About
White One Auto is a family owned business with a passion for automobiles. Maurice is the steward behind the shop. He got his start early, working on cars with his uncle in his family's driveway, and today he's a state certified ASE Master Mechanic and Team Supervisor.
Our philosophy is simple. We don't want to fix your car one time, we want to fix it every time. That means accurate diagnosing, fair pricing and getting your vehicle back to you on time, whether the job is big or small.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 69 reviews, and we hope to join in relationship with you to keep your vehicle safely on the road.

## Services
- Electrical Diagnosis & Repair: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems, including wiring harness repair and builds.
- Engine Work: Engine repair handled by people who are happy to turn a wrench.
- Bolt Extraction: Getting stuck and broken bolts out without making things worse.
- Disc Brake Conversion: Converting your vehicle's brakes to disc brakes.
- Engine Re Builds/Machining Onsite: Engine rebuilds with machining done right here in the shop.
- Spark Plug Extraction: Removing stuck or broken spark plugs.
- Transmission Rebuilds: Rebuilding transmissions to get your car or truck shifting right again.
- Computer Programming: Vehicle computer programming using the latest diagnostic technology.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on trucks too?
A: Yes. Your car or truck is in the best of hands with us.

Q: Do you offer preventative maintenance?
A: Yes. We offer many preventative maintenance options. It's the convenient way to keep your car healthy.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If needed, you will hear back within 24 hours.
